description: This file defines a Redis-based vector store component for a machine learning or data retrieval system, including a class Redis_VectorStores with methods for upserting documents and initializing the store, along with utility functions for Redis interactions and similarity search.

classes.name: Redis_VectorStores
classes.description: A class implementing a Redis-backed vector store with methods for upserting documents and initializing the store, supporting similarity search and index management.

methods.name: vectorStoreMethods
methods.description: Contains the asynchronous method 'upsert' for inserting documents into Redis and setting up similarity search.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the Redis vector store, creates Redis client, and configures similarity search based on node data inputs.
